d:
desh ke kone-kone se prerna, navachar aur sakaratmak badlavon ki ansuni kahaniyan!
Janbhagidari ke anuthe prayason, deshvasiyon ki uplabdhiyon aur rashtr nirman men unke yogdan ko janne-sunne ka avsar lekar aa raha hai pradhanmantri shri narendr modi ka lokapriy karyakram ‘man ki bat’.
Sunie desh ke alag-alag hisson se ubharti prernadayak kahaniyan aur un logon ke anubhav, jo apne prayason se samaj men badlav la rahe hain.
jurna na bhulen ‘man ki bat’ ke sath, is ravivar, 29 navanbar ko subah 11 baje, sirph didi jharkhand par!
